Something thing to keep in mind is that the total Contacts include Mailing Lists as contacts

Another part of the equation could be the address book's auxiliary files, for example "abook.sqlite-shm" and abook.sqlite-wal. So, if you still have a misbehaving address book, that would be something to try.
